title: Чужая ткань
source: User requested self-designed 20-session main arc after ~5-year leap but stopped the leap explicitly before execution
skip_gate: Authorized in direct player instruction: five-year time skip executed from 1278-09-19 to 1283-09-19. Stop at first personally observed event 1283-09-19 07:23 in Kusa hospital.
premise: Years after Konoha invasion, border medicine and public safety clash over covert graft research. A network saved some people while exploiting others. Old tissue-compatibility registry is evidence and leverage, not proof Shiki's anomaly was engineered.
setting_rules: No Otsutsuki/Kaguya, godlike city-destroying abilities, infinite chakra or guaranteed DNA assimilation
Physiological treatments take time and have consequences; Shiki's Zero Genome self-limited by mastery
NPC autonomy, independent motives, bounded knowledge, witness-gated acquisition; NEVER show offscreen GM-only scenes as player-known
Causal branching: player agency, no forced Shiki thoughts, speech, consent, life choices or moral stance
